UPDATE competitor_products cp LEFT JOIN category_age_tier_baseline b ON b.marketplace COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = cp.marketplace COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND b.bsr_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = cp.bsr_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND b.baseline_month = #{baselineMonth} AND b.age_bucket = CASE WHEN cp.listing_days < 30 THEN '0_30' WHEN cp.listing_days < 60 THEN '30_60' WHEN cp.listing_days < 90 THEN '60_90' ELSE NULL END SET cp.m04_age_bucket = CASE WHEN cp.listing_days IS NULL OR cp.weight_g IS NULL OR cp.listing_days >= 90 OR cp.weight_g >= 300 THEN 'out_of_scope' WHEN cp.listing_days < 30 THEN '0_30' WHEN cp.listing_days < 60 THEN '30_60' ELSE '60_90' END, cp.m04_tier = CASE WHEN cp.listing_days IS NULL OR cp.weight_g IS NULL OR cp.listing_days >= 90 OR cp.weight_g >= 300 THEN 'out_of_scope' WHEN b.id IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN cp.units >= b.units_p90 THEN 'S' WHEN cp.units >= b.units_p75 THEN 'A' WHEN cp.units >= b.units_p50 THEN 'B' WHEN cp.units >= b.units_p25 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END, cp.m04_units_pct = CASE WHEN b.id IS NULL OR cp.units IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN cp.units >= b.units_p90 THEN 0.90 WHEN cp.units >= b.units_p75 THEN 0.75 WHEN cp.units >= b.units_p50 THEN 0.50 WHEN cp.units >= b.units_p25 THEN 0.25 ELSE 0.00 END, cp.m04_bsr_pct = CASE WHEN b.id IS NULL OR cp.bsr IS NULL OR cp.bsr <= 0 THEN NULL WHEN cp.bsr <= b.bsr_p10 THEN 0.90 WHEN cp.bsr <= b.bsr_p25 THEN 0.75 WHEN cp.bsr <= b.bsr_p50 THEN 0.50 WHEN cp.bsr <= b.bsr_p75 THEN 0.25 ELSE 0.00 END, cp.m04_computed_at = NOW() WHERE cp.week_tag = #{weekTag} AND cp.month = #{baselineMonth}
AND cp.marketplace = #{marketplace}
